component.name: Lapin
component.summary: Desktop client of the Lapin self-hosted voice assistant
Client de bureau de l'assistant vocal auto-hébergé Lapin

description.p: Press a shortcut and a small card opens at the bottom of the screen: it listens, shows what it heard and the answer, and speaks the answer. Speech recognition, the language model and the voices run on your own Lapin server.
The assistant can act on this computer: open apps, folders and links, control media and the volume, lock the screen, take screenshots, use the clipboard. Power actions ask for confirmation.
